0022600219.text: The Raptors (5-5, 2-2 at home, 6th in the East) are looking to bounce back from a loss and host the Celtics (8-2, 5-0 at home, 2nd in the East), who have won three straight. Toronto will be without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), while Collin Murray-Boyles (illness), Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), and Trayce Jackson-Davis (illness) are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and Boston swept the 2025-26 series 4-0, most recently beating the Raptors 115-101 in Boston on April 5, 2026.
